howto.what: 装上后,当你拿技术内容问它时,Claude 会用大白话把它拆成 who、what、where、why、when 五个方面讲给你听,产出平白的解释而不是术语堆砌。
howto.when: 当你想要某段技术内容的平白解释、需要弄清它的 who、what、where、why、when 时触发。

say.text: 用大白话给我讲讲这段技术内容
这个 API 是谁在用、做什么、为什么用?
say.note: 得到平白的五方面说明

say.text: 把这个报错的前因后果用大白话讲清

howto.what_en: Once installed, when you ask about something technical, Claude breaks it down in plain English across the who, what, where, why, and when — giving you a plain explanation instead of jargon.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want a plain-English breakdown of something technical — its who, what, where, why, and when.

say_en.text: Explain this technical thing to me in plain English
say_en.note: It breaks it into who, what, where, why, when

say_en.text: Who uses this API, for what, and why?
say_en.note: You get a plain take on all five angles

say_en.text: Walk me through this error in plain English
say_en.note: Split into who, what, where, why, when
